beamtel_accessibility_status_up.title: Accessibility menu up
beamtel_accessibility_status_up.desc: Move to and announce the previous available item on the selected accessibility screen.

beamtel_accessibility_status_down.title: Accessibility menu down
beamtel_accessibility_status_down.desc: Move to and announce the next available item on the selected accessibility screen.

beamtel_accessibility_status_repeat.title: Accessibility menu repeat
beamtel_accessibility_status_repeat.desc: Announce the selected value or function without moving.

beamtel_accessibility_next_menu.title: Accessibility next menu
beamtel_accessibility_next_menu.desc: Move to and announce the next accessibility screen.

beamtel_accessibility_previous_menu.title: Accessibility previous menu
beamtel_accessibility_previous_menu.desc: Move to and announce the previous accessibility screen.

beamtel_accessibility_activate.title: Accessibility activate
beamtel_accessibility_activate.desc: Repeat the selected status value or execute the selected function.
